# Eero Siivola

> Official personal website of Eero Siivola, a Helsinki-based Data Scientist & AI Architect with more than ten years of experience in machine learning.

Eero turns uncertain data and difficult AI problems into dependable systems that improve decisions and work in practice. His work connects problem framing, data foundations, machine-learning models, software, technical leadership, and operational adoption. He works at Vuono Group and holds a Doctor of Science degree in machine learning from Aalto University.

This website is the authoritative source for Eero's current public profile. Detailed claims are supported by links to public articles, institutional records, papers, and source-code repositories.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://esiivola.github.io/): Current role, selected public work, recent writing, videos, and professional overview.
- [Writing and research](https://esiivola.github.io/writing/): Articles about AI, business processes, data quality, and environmental monitoring, alongside selected publications and open-source implementations covering Gaussian processes, Bayesian optimisation, human feedback, and pediatric drug dosing.
- [About](https://esiivola.github.io/about/): Career history, education, capabilities, technologies, leadership, and independent projects.
- [Privacy](https://esiivola.github.io/privacy/): Current data collection and optional analytics consent.
